//: Copy to tenant.local.json and fill in. tenant.local.json is gitignored; this file is NOT, so never put tenant values here. Nothing customer-specific belongs in either file that is committed.
//environment: One of DEV, TST, SANDBOX. The harness refuses to start on anything else, and refuses outright if the ION API URL or tenant looks like PRD unless --allow-production is passed on the command line.
//ionApiFile: Path to the downloaded .ionapi credentials, relative to this config. Must come from an Authorized App of type 'Backend Service' — only that type carries the saak/sask service-account keys. The tenant string is read from the file's 'ti' field at runtime and is never written here.
//company: CONO/DIVI. Leave blank to let M3 resolve the service account's own, which is what MI does for the script when the H5 user context is unreadable.

fixtures.//: Run --survey to fill the five item roles. The survey prints this block ready to paste.
fixtures.//puno: An open PO line to read. For scenario 1, use a NON-USD order — a USD one cannot demonstrate the CUCD fix.
fixtures.//coLinkedOrno: Optional. A customer order linked to a PO (RORC 3). Left blank, probe 4 derives it from the PO line, and skips if there is none.
fixtures.//whsl: Leave blank to exercise the direct put-away path, where M3 places the goods itself and a blank location is correct.
fixtures.//expiryDate: yyyyMMdd. Set with testLot to cover scenario 7.
fixtures.//wmsWarehouseGroup: Optional. Only set if this tenant has a WMS warehouse group to check (scenario 11).
fixtures.//cms474: The CMS474 custom field used for serials over 40 characters. Probe 10 only needs these to form a well-shaped key; it never creates a row.

whsHeader.//: MHS850MI/AddWhsHead partner keys. E0PA/E0PB and E065 together resolve the MMS865 partner record M3 uses to interpret the message. These MUST match a partner record that exists on this tenant, or AddWhsHead is refused. See CONFIGURATION.md.
